concerns.text: Task T012b (Stream & Process Data) depends on T012c (Initialize CLIP model), but T012c is listed AFTER T012b in the task sequence. T012b cannot execute the CLIP model initialization logic if the model initialization task (T012c) has not yet been completed. The order must be T012c -> T012b.

Task T029a (Generate Velocity Vectors from Tree Routing) depends on T021 (Trained Trees), but T021 is listed AFTER T029a in the task sequence. T029a requires the trained tree models to generate predictions, so T021 must precede T029a.

Task T028a (Generate Teacher and Tree Images - Pilot) depends on T029a (Generate Velocity Vectors), but T029a is listed AFTER T028a. T028a requires the velocity vectors generated by T029a to run the Euler integrator. The order must be T029a -> T028a.

Task T030a (Compute FID and CLIP Scores - Pilot) depends on T028a (Generate Pilot Images), but T028a is listed AFTER T030a. T030a cannot compute metrics on images that have not been generated. The order must be T028a -> T030a.

Task T030b (Run Pilot Variance Calculation) depends on T030a (Compute Metrics), but T030a is listed AFTER T030b. T030b requires the CLIP scores calculated in T030a to estimate variance. The order must be T030a -> T030b.

Task T030c (Calculate Power and Configure Sample Size) depends on T030b (Pilot Variance), but T030b is listed AFTER T030c. T030c requires the variance estimate from T030b to calculate the required sample size. The order must be T030b -> T030c.

Task T028b (Generate Teacher and Tree Images - Full) depends on T030c (Sample Size Config), but T030c is listed AFTER T028b. T028b requires the sample size determined in T030c to know how many images to generate. The order must be T030c -> T028b.

Task T030d (Compute FID and CLIP Scores - Full) depends on T028b (Generate Full Images), but T028b is listed AFTER T030d. T030d cannot compute metrics on images that have not been generated. The order must be T028b -> T030d.

Task T030e (Perform Statistical Tests) depends on T030d (Full Metrics), but T030d is listed AFTER T030e. T030e requires the full metrics calculated in T030d to perform statistical tests. The order must be T030d -> T030e.

Task T042 (Implement Robust Real Data Streaming Fetch) is listed in Phase N+1 (Revision & Review Resolution) but is a foundational data fetching task required for US1 (Phase 3). It should be moved to Phase 3 or Phase 2 (Foundational) to ensure data availability before US1 implementation tasks like T012b and T013a.
Task T043 (Add Data Source Verification & Hashing) depends on T042, but T042 is in Phase N+1. If T042 is moved to Phase 3, T043 must follow immediately after T042 in Phase 3, not in Phase N+1.

Task T044 (Explicitly Handle Undefined Routing Paths) refines T013a, but T013a is in Phase 3. T044 should be integrated into Phase 3 (T013a) or placed immediately after T013a in Phase 3, not in Phase N+1.

Task T045 (Validate Statistical Power Calculation) refines T030c, but T030c is in Phase 5. T045 should be integrated into Phase 5 (T030c) or placed immediately after T030c in Phase 5, not in Phase N+1.

Task T046 (Prevent Overfitting in Decision Tree Training) refines T021, but T021 is in Phase 4. T046 should be integrated into Phase 4 (T021) or placed immediately after T021 in Phase 4, not in Phase N+1.
